notes.title: Uninvited 1.13 hotfix
notes.notes:
1.13 hotfix:


 Fixed the "Survivor" achievement.
 Fixed a bug where the game registered the player as "running" while inside the closet.
 Player don't sweat anymore while an item is activated.

notes.title: Uninvited 1.12 hotfix
notes.notes:
1.12 hotfix:

- Decreased the ghost killing range.
- Fixed a bug where the code panel got frozen on screen when the player is killed.

notes.title: Uninvited 1.11 hotfix
notes.notes:
Uninvited 1.11 patch notes:

- Fixed a bug that broke the game when crossing doors in some circumstances.

notes.title: Uninvited 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thank you for your support! We hope you're enjoying your time in the Morgan's House! :)

We have a small update for you:


 Added an Easy Mode, for those of you who are struggling too much with the game.
 Fixed a bug where some items got frozen on the screen.


We'll keep releasing patches fixing bugs and improving the game in the upcoming days.

Thank you so much for your patience!

Octavi & Susanna

notes.title: Uninvited Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have very exciting news for you! Uninvited already has a release date!! Yay!
Our weird and peculiar horror game will see the light on May 25.

The countdown begins!

Octavi & Susanna
